sources.title: Best Vision Models You Can Run Locally: Every Model, Every GPU Tier
sources.snippet: Quick Answer: Qwen 3.6-27B dense (~17 GB VRAM, Apache 2.0) is the new state-of-the-art local vision model on 24GB+ GPUs — vision is baked into the base model, no separate VL track. Gemma 4 26B-A4B (~18 GB) is the fast multimodal pick with 3.8B active params per token. For 16GB or less, Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B MoE with --cpu-moe works well.
